subject: logs
text: - NEVER use `print!` / `println!` / `eprint!` / `eprintln!` / `dbg!` in the `hook`, `run` or `mcp` code paths of the product crates (`viola-harness` and the fake agent are exempt, §3 obs-ci-gate-wire). They bypass the file sink and break the Hook contract, the `run` terminal rule and MCP framing. Enforced by `[workspace.lints.clippy]` `print_stdout`, `print_stderr`, `dbg_macro` = `deny` under the §9 clippy step. Only the output modules that own `--json`, human CLI stderr and the hook decision body may carry a local `#[allow]`, and only where they use a print macro — `run`'s and `revive`'s pre-spawn refusals, `revive --list`'s, `verify`'s, `list`'s and `plugin install`'s refusals, and the instance-check refusal of `link` / `unlink` and of `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release`, write through `src/human.rs` (`refuse` / `write_refusal`, one `write_all` on the locked stderr; callers `run` 7 · `verify` 6 · `list` 2 · `revive` 1 · `plugin install` 1 · `client` 1, the one `refuse_untrusted` site `link` / `unlink` and the six frame verbs share; the rule: the `human::refuse(` call sites under `src/`), which uses no print macro and carries no `#[allow]` — plus the fake agent's crate-level `#![allow]` in `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs` (a root-package bin, §3 obs-ci-gate-wire).
